T-291 is in review: the send-path guard and the switch-off behaviour are deployed to the live centre and pushed, `/preview` stays open until the trigger fires, and F-1aada045 is acked. The local close-preview probe passes all 23 checks and live checks confirm the guard; the day-output hold has no dedicated check, and `probe-live-qa`'s last UI step fails the same way on the old script.

decisions.decision: Clear the blocker and the ask to Adi. Do all the prep now. Change the trigger and done-when from 'Adi says the build is complete' to: flip the setting before the first non-test attendee is sent a centre link, or as soon as Adi calls the build complete in review, whichever comes first. Keep /preview open until then, as Adi asked on 2026-10-05. Now: list every user of /preview (fill-preview.mjs, the walkers, the hub and playbook review links, the T-214 Tantra demo funnel, T-278). Point each one that must keep working at a personal test-attendee link and prove each still works. Add a check to the invite and send path that refuses to send a real attendee their centre link while open_preview is on. When the trigger fires, set Cohort Settings to 'Off: personal links only'. Confirm a signed-out GET /preview no longer opens the centre and a personal link still does, then log the date.
decisions.why: Adi wanted /preview open until the build is complete and closing it later. The orchestrator-autonomy rule says choosing the timing is our call. No real cohort is running yet (T-234 pass 2 correction), so tying the switch-off to the first real link-out is safe and needs nothing from Adi.

decisions.decision: Do not flip the setting yet: neither trigger has fired, and /preview stays open as Adi asked on 2026-10-05. Close the one gap you reported. Add checks to app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs that prove a real attendee's day output is held while open_preview is on and released once it is off (jobs-delivery.ts heldByPreview path). Run the probe on the local centre, commit and push. Remove the 'Adi: reply build complete' ask from the task; replace it with a plain line that the 409 guard forces the switch-off before any real attendee can be added, and that whoever adds the first real attendee (or the T-228 welcome-email build) flips it using the steps in the spec. Then leave the task in review, waiting on the trigger, with no ask to Adi. When the trigger fires, flip, confirm 403 on /preview and the demo personal link, and log the date.
